title.zh-CN: 引产后反复大量流血 · 31岁女性
title.en: Recurrent heavy bleeding after delivery · woman aged 31

summary.zh-CN: 产后出血反复，短暂好转后再次出现，需复核影像、清宫所见及组织证据。
summary.en: Postpartum bleeding recurs after temporary improvement; reassess imaging, evacuation findings and tissue evidence.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

reviewers: AI-assisted editorial source and guidance check; not a licensed clinician
guidelines: WHO, FIGO, ICM. Consolidated guidelines for prevention, diagnosis and treatment of postpartum haemorrhage. 2025. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240115637

notes.zh-CN: 已对照所列权威资料进行人工智能辅助编辑核对；未由执业医师审核。原报告罕见表现及方案仍需专科确认。
notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 以复发时间线识别残留组织解释的不足。
learningOutcomes.en: Use recurrence to recognise the limits of a retained-tissue explanation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 以病理而非外观区分肌层坏死和胎盘残留。
learningOutcomes.en: Use histology rather than appearance to distinguish myometrial necrosis from placenta.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释无高热和培养阴性并不等于无感染。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why absent high fever and negative cultures do not equal absent infection.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别反复休克与坏死组织，避免无证据重复清宫
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise recurrent shock and necrotic tissue and avoid unsupported repeat evacuation

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 引产后反复阴道多量流血3天
chiefComplaint.en: Three days of recurrent heavy vaginal bleeding after induced delivery

triageNote.zh-CN: 曾因出血出现休克，经清宫、输血和促宫缩后出血减少，再次转诊评估。
triageNote.en: Previous haemorrhagic shock improved after evacuation, transfusion and uterotonics; the patient is referred for reassessment.

name.en: Expelled tissue and later operative pathology

zh-CN: 排出组织与后续手术病理
en: Expelled tissue and later operative pathology

text.zh-CN: 宫颈组织为大片子宫肌层坏死及炎性渗出；后续宫底切除未见绒毛。最终子宫病理仍有肌层坏死，并有皮下化脓性炎症；引流培养阴性。
text.en: Cervical tissue contained extensive necrotic myometrium and inflammatory exudate; later fundal resection contained no villi. Final hysterectomy pathology again showed myometrial necrosis, with suppurative subcutaneous inflammation; drainage cultures were negative.

text.zh-CN: 报告宫腔镜分离时发生穿孔，曾行宫底楔形切除；后又大量出血并发现感染，最终子宫切除，随后治愈出院。历史手术次序不是今天必须照搬的路径。
text.en: Hysteroscopic separation caused perforation and was followed by fundal wedge resection. Further haemorrhage and infection led to hysterectomy, followed by recovery and discharge. That historical sequence is not a required modern pathway.

prompt.zh-CN: 反复出血且宫腔清空后，应怎样扩展判断？
prompt.en: How should the assessment expand when bleeding recurs after cavity clearance?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 复核坏死感染及肌层病变等继发产后出血原因
text.en: Reassess necrotic/infectious and myometrial causes of secondary postpartum haemorrhage

feedback.zh-CN: 反复清宫后仍出血和子宫异常需要超越残留物单一解释。
feedback.en: Bleeding and uterine abnormalities after repeated evacuation require more than a retained-tissue explanation.

text.zh-CN: 永远按残留胎盘重复清宫即可
text.en: Continue repeated evacuation for presumed retained placenta indefinitely

feedback.zh-CN: 缺少持续残留证据，脆弱子宫可能面临进一步损伤。
feedback.en: Persistent retained tissue is not established, and a fragile uterus risks further injury.

text.zh-CN: 没有高热即排除严重感染
text.en: Absence of high fever excludes serious infection

feedback.zh-CN: 本例感染和坏死可以缺乏明显发热。
feedback.en: Infection and necrosis in this case were not accompanied by prominent fever.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 病理证实坏死肌层，阴性培养不否定组织炎症
text.en: Pathology establishes myometrial necrosis; negative cultures do not erase tissue inflammation

feedback.zh-CN: 病理和培养回答不同问题，不能相互替代。
feedback.en: Histology and culture answer different questions and are not interchangeable.

text.zh-CN: 所有胎盘样组织都是残留胎盘
text.en: All placenta-like material is retained placenta

feedback.zh-CN: 形似不等于绒毛组织，原报告多次病理未支持这一假设。
feedback.en: Appearance is not villous histology; repeated pathology did not support that assumption.

text.zh-CN: 凝血正常可排除危及生命的出血
text.en: Normal coagulation excludes life-threatening haemorrhage

feedback.zh-CN: 局部出血源和坏死可在正常凝血检查时造成严重失血。
feedback.en: A local source and necrosis can cause severe blood loss despite normal coagulation tests.

prompt.zh-CN: 此时安全的管理原则是什么？
prompt.en: What is the safe management principle at this stage?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 复苏与产科感染源控制并行，评估脆弱子宫及手术风险并讨论必要手术
text.en: Resuscitation alongside obstetric source control, assessment of uterine fragility and operative risk, and discussion of necessary surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 反复休克和肌层坏死需有输血及手术资源的专业团队。
feedback.en: Recurrent shock and myometrial necrosis require a team with transfusion and operative capability.

text.zh-CN: 不顾既有病理继续盲目搔刮
text.en: Continue blind curettage despite the pathology

feedback.zh-CN: 坏死肌层增加穿孔和出血风险，需重新评估手段。
feedback.en: Necrotic myometrium increases perforation and bleeding risk and requires reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 只靠口服抗菌药等待所有出血自行停止
text.en: Wait for all bleeding to stop with oral antibiotics alone

feedback.zh-CN: 生命威胁性出血和坏死源可能需要即时控制。
feedback.en: Life-threatening haemorrhage and necrotic tissue may require immediate control.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：以复发时间线识别残留组织解释的不足。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：具体病原、完整输血总量、影像肌层厚度矛盾及长期心理和手术恢复。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Use recurrence to recognise the limits of a retained-tissue explanation. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Specific pathogen, complete transfusion totals, inconsistent reported myometrial thickness and long-term psychological/surgical recovery. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告诊断坏死性子宫肌炎、子宫内膜炎及反复失血性休克，最终切除子宫控制病灶。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed necrotising myometritis, endometritis and recurrent haemorrhagic shock, ultimately controlled by hysterectomy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 以复发时间线识别残留组织解释的不足。

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 具体病原、完整输血总量、影像肌层厚度矛盾及长期心理和手术恢复。
unknowns.en: Specific pathogen, complete transfusion totals, inconsistent reported myometrial thickness and long-term psychological/surgical recovery.

testUtterances.text: 分娩后多久开始大量流血？
How soon after delivery did heavy bleeding begin?
出血后来有没有反复？
Did the bleeding recur?
这次在多少周、什么情况下分娩？
At what gestation and under what circumstances was delivery?
分娩前有没有破水？
Did membranes rupture before delivery?
大量流血时有没有头晕心慌？
Were you dizzy or aware of a racing heart during bleeding?
出血的时候会冒汗、手脚冷或喘吗？
Were you sweaty, cold or breathless while bleeding?
此前为止血做过哪些处理？
What treatments have been used to stop bleeding?
有没有清宫、缝合或输血？
Was evacuation, repair or transfusion performed?
以前做过剖宫产或流产手术吗？
Have you had a caesarean or abortion procedure before?
之前子宫做过几次手术？
How many previous uterine procedures were there?
出血时有没有发热或畏寒？
Was there fever or chills during bleeding?
那时会不会打寒战？
Were you shivering at the time?
怀孕以前有哪些长期疾病？
What long-term illnesses existed before pregnancy?
孕前有没有需要持续治疗的问题？
Did any condition require ongoing care before pregnancy?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
以前有没有预防接种方面的情况？
Could you describe any vaccinations?
